note: How the motion room is organised: every piece belongs to one series. Episode series group each episode with the cuts derived from it (vertical, carousel, card) by id prefix. The studio site and tools/manifest.mjs read this; pieces.json stays the render catalogue.

series.title: Season One: The Island Keeps Everything
series.shape: 10 story episodes · 60 s · 1920×1080, each with a 9:16 vertical, a 4:5 carousel and a 4:5 card
series.logline: A quokka arrives on a quiet island with its thoughts blowing everywhere, learns to keep them, and as the seasons turn everything it made is still there, in plain files.

series.title: Rotli in 30 seconds
series.shape: 8 feature explainers · 30 s · 1920×1080, each with a 9:16 vertical, a 4:5 carousel and a 4:5 card
series.logline: One feature per episode, shown in the app: title, demo, end card. The launch month's backbone.

series.title: The Rotli Story
series.shape: the 60 s film (sealed) · its 15 s vertical recut · hero and social cards from its sunset
series.logline: The first film: the quokka on Rottnest, from the ferry to the sunset. It is locked; its golden must always print SAME.

series.title: Make it yours

series.logline: The companion and the themes, drawn from the app's real <Character> and theme tokens.
